title: Northstar Habit Map — weekly KPI scratchpad
body:
Purpose: lightweight, actionable weekly map that ties daily habits -> weekly signals -> northstar proxy. Not an engineering report; a personal cadence to surface blockers and maintain momentum.

Week window: 2025-11-10 -> 2025-11-16
Context: Sprint focus is inference cache MVP, prototype batching heuristics, and one small perf regression fix. Goal is to move KR2 and keep personal disruption < 2 days.

Northstar hypothesis (working): if I maintain a 10pt/week habit score while shipping one meaningful experiment and closing regressions, my throughput to KR accomplishment scales by ~1.5x over a quarter.

OKR Draft (personal, mapped to eng-serving-runtime KR set):
- Objective: Increase dependable delivery velocity for small infra experiments while keeping quality regressions at zero.
  - KR1: Ship 3 batching experiments with telemetry by EOW (target: 3)
  - KR2: Reduce median prefix cache miss latency by 25% on test cluster (target: -25%)
  - KR3: Maintain <=1 post-deploy rollback across 4 deploys (target: <=1)

Weekly commitments (what I'll actually do this week):
- M: prototype adaptive batch cut-off; run 2 workloads; document perf notes
- T: integrate simple KV expiry into cache shim; small e2e smoke tests
- W: pair-review Miguel's batching PR; finish perf harness for latency measurement
- Th: run Canary with 10% traffic on dedicated test pool; collect traces
- F: analyze telemetry, prepare short write-up + add to PR description
- Sa/Su: buffer / recovery / unblock refactor if needed

Micro-habit heatmap (daily signals tracked as 0..3 scale where 3=complete/green, 0=missed):
Rows: Focus hours (50-min blocks), PR progress (size/meaningful diff), Unblocks (number), Deep debugging sessions
Mon  Tue  Wed  Thu  Fri  Sat  Sun
Fhrs   2    3    2    1    2    0    0
PR     1    2    3    1    2    0    0
Unblk  0    1    1    2    1    0    0
DBug   0    1    0    2    1    0    0

Weekly habit score = sum(all cells). This week raw = 2+3+2+1+2+0+0 + 1+2+3+1+2+0+0 + 0+1+1+2+1+0+0 + 0+1+0+2+1+0+0 = 27
Baseline steady-state target = 24 (baseline); green band = 26+

Scoring rubric (experimental, for quick decisions):
- If weekly habit score >= 26 AND at least 1 experiment shipped -> "Go" for creating follow-up tickets and scheduling next batch experiment.
- If weekly habit score < 20 -> force a 1-day reset (no new experiments) to catch up on unblocks/documentation.
- If a regression occurs -> immediate rollback + 0 new experiment policy until retro.

Retrospective (quick bullets):
- Wins: Paired review on Wed accelerated the batching PR; found a low-hanging perf drop in KV shim that I could fix in <2 hours.
- Misses: Thurs canary had noisy traces; I didn't have a quick sampling dashboard — blocked analysis for ~6h. Need pre-defined trace slices.
- Surprises: Memory backpressure showed up only under long-sequence tests; not seen in short unit tests. Add a stress script to CI.

Immediate actions (next 7 days):
- (A1) Add trace sampling dashboard skeleton (Confluence note + ticket) -> linked: JIRA-1234 (blocking)
- (A2) Add stress script to perf harness and run weekly smoke (github PR 60, WIP)
- (A3) Schedule 1-hour pairing with observability team (Aisha) to standardize trace slices
- (A4) Add a short post-canary checklist to PR template (5 bullets)

Confidence dial (subjective): 6/10. Enough momentum to ship experiments but shaky on observability which costed me ~6h.

Notes to self / scratch ideas (free form):
- Micro-commit windows: try two 90-min deep windows instead of three 50-min blocks one day to see throughput difference.
- If canary noise > threshold, add fallback policy to route to older model variant. Draft fallback YAML while debug traces are sparse.
- Consider a small bot to tag traces that co-occur with cache-miss spikes (heuristic + regex).

Open questions (for retro / async comment):
- Is 24 the right baseline or artificially low because sprint task sizes have drifted? (ask manager)
- Should I reduce the OKR ship target to 2 experimentally to focus on quality?

Linked references in doc:
- perf-harness readme (local): github.com/redwood-inference/perf-harness#stress
- Confluence: /display/ENG/perf-harness-weekly-report
- JIRA: JIRA-1234 (trace sampling), JIRA-1289 (batching experiments epics)

Toggle for next iteration: make habit heatmap binary (done/not-done) and add time-spent buckets only if I need more granularity. For now the 0..3 scale feels light-weight.

End of scratchpad. Will snapshot and convert into a short retrospective note next Friday.

Signature: Samir I. — quick log maintained for personal cadence and to seed weekly update to manager.
